sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T Case No.104 of 2025 pending in the Court of learned District Sessions Judge, Jagatsinghpur, arising out of Balikuda P.S. Case No.177 o f 2 0 2 5 f o r c o m m i s s i o n o f o f f e n c e p u n i s h a b l e u n d e r S e c t i o n s 376(2)(n)/493/313/341/294/323/354/506/34 of IPC and Section 3(1)(r)/ 3(1)(s) and 3(2)(va) of SC & ST (POA) Act.
Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Diary.
4. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioners shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
5. It is needless to say that the Petitioners shall cooperate with the ongoing investigation.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Soumya Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL
